site.title: YULA Lab — We design tomorrow's products today.
site.description: YULA Lab is a venture studio building AI-native, data-driven products that simplify everyday life.

footer.tagline: A venture studio that uses AI in the right place at the right time, without overstating it.

landing.heroDescription: YULA Lab is a venture studio that designs AI-native, data-driven products that simplify everyday life. Every project is built at the intersection of aesthetics, ethics, and impact.
landing.visionBody: Build a family of products that meaningfully improves human life by bringing the best of AI into everyday hands.
landing.missionBody: Build an engineering culture that combines transparent methodology, minimal design and real user value — using AI exactly where it helps, never just because it can.
landing.manifestoNote: An engineering culture built on four values.

manifesto.title: With craft, not haste.
manifesto.intro: YULA Lab is a venture studio that leans on evidence, not trends. Each of our three products is a different face of the same discipline: making a measurable difference in human life through restrained, transparent design.

projectsIndex.title: The family.
projectsIndex.intro: Three products, one discipline. Each speaks its own design language; underneath, the same engineering culture, the same transparency, the same calm user experience.

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.intro: An idea, a piece of feedback, a press request, or just hello — email is the fastest way to reach us. We usually reply within 48 hours.
contact.generalHint: For partnerships, collaborations, product and technical questions.
contact.pressHint: Interviews, event invitations and press release requests.
